a:r.a:t: Late Stage Deals that we expect to close in Q2 & Q3

In flight pursuit via Cognizant on the existing MSA (Otera as agentic delivery partner; ~20% reseller economics). Client praised Otera's demo as standout versus competing vendors. Two use cases — bodily injury + workers' comp — for end-to-end claims transformation, then offshore. Timeline shifted to Q3/Q4.

Solution-design workshop held 18 Jun (invoice–contract check across ~4,000 contracts); target design + business case being defined. Two production claims use cases (~15K/yr) scoped at kickoff. CFO (Franz) engaged. Deal progressing.

Competitive three-way (AWS, UiPath, Otera). Otera runs the P&C/property-claims pilot stream; AWS holds motor/autopilot. Winning depends on over-delivering the pilot, expected to start Early July with contract close end June.

Production pilot proposal under client review, with a third-party risk assessment in progress. Two options: 2 states (AL+SC) vs all 3 (+MS). Competitive bake-off on liability- and coverage-determination agents; marquee US insurer sharing real claims data.
LOI signed; production-pilot order form in final signing (client confirmed in writing, expected this week). 12-week Swiss order-intake/DPC pilot already underway
(→ September). Converted from the Hackathon Launch Pack (100% LP→rollout rate). Plan: win the narrow Swiss scope, then expand to full rollout.

Verbal commitment to a €100K claims pilot after a board-level review; next-steps meeting underway. Champion: COO Mark Kottmann (ex-Allianz). Watch-outs: buying-committee skepticism (Stefan Hanzel, ex-Capgemini) and a parallel internal-AI evaluation ("Omnia").

Expansion strongly delayed; Pega contract taking priority, Otera explicitly deprioritized until that closes. Champion acknowledges Otera is next in line but gave no timeline commitment. 25k EUR overage could be offset against expansion contract if signed in June — unlikely given current delay. +258k ARR at risk of pushing to Q3 or later. Recommended action: bypass champion, engage EB and budget holder directly to create top-down pressure.

Commercial discussions on hold post-holidays; EB back last week, meeting not yet booked. P2P team likely moving to Hypatos, shrinking expansion scope. Champion shows no urgency on current contract. Q3 expansion (100M credit / +280k ARR) nominally on track but risk elevated due to time lost and unresolved scope. Next step: lock in EB meeting before Q3 slips.
Offer presented to Pieter who took it to Sirma and the board and now the opcos are working on the demand which will be followed by final negotiations and approval
